tasks.title: [Phase 0] Supabase project config, transaction pooler & secrets
tasks.description: Connect the Supabase project (id nngjqhrxbhugnafyviqj), configure the transaction pooler, and establish the secrets model.
tasks.details:
DECISION (2026-06-23): project runs on Supabase FREE tier, not Pro (Build Guide §1 assumed Pro). Verified the full Momzo architecture works on Free: RLS+indexes, Supavisor transaction pooler (6543, prepared statements OFF), pgvector, pg_cron, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage signed URLs. Free-tier consequences: NO automated daily backups (see backups TODO below) and 7-day inactivity auto-pause. All server-side DB access via the transaction pooler on port 6543 with prepared statements OFF (Supavisor transaction mode). Direct 5432 not used. Env established: anon key in app/env.json; service_role + LLM keys ONLY in supabase/.env (git-ignored). BACKUPS TODO (pre-launch, before real family data): either upgrade to Pro for daily backups or schedule a pg_dump cron — track as a Phase 3 / launch-readiness item.
Hard Rules: #2 pooler 6543 + prepared statements off; #5 service_role server-side only; §5 secrets matrix.
tasks.testStrategy: A server-side test query succeeds through the 6543 pooler with prepared statements disabled; service_role key confirmed absent from app bundle + repo. (Pro/backups requirement dropped — Free tier; backups deferred to launch-readiness.)

tasks.title: [Phase 0] Core database schema + RLS + indexes (migrations)
tasks.description: Author the full Postgres schema (PRD §8) with RLS enabled on every table and an index on every policy-filtered column. Version-controlled SQL only.
tasks.details:
Create all tables from PRD §8: users, children, family_members(P2), content_cards, content_embeddings(pgvector), daily_assignments, activities, activity_logs, ai_conversations, ai_messages, questions, question_responses, wishes, scheduled_events, reminders, milestones. Enable pgvector. created_at/updated_at on all. Validate child age 6-10. Enable RLS on EVERY public table with simple, fast policies: USING ((select auth.uid()) = owner_id) style; for child-scoped rows resolve ownership via the owning parent. Index every column any policy filters on (owner_id, child_id, user_id, etc.). Keep policies as direct comparisons, no IN-subqueries (defer membership lookups to P2 security-definer fn).
Hard Rules: #1 RLS+index every table; #3 direct comparisons, wrap auth.uid(); #19 migrations only.
tasks.testStrategy: All migrations apply cleanly via `supabase db push`. `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` on typical per-family queries stays <50ms and uses the index. RLS is enabled on every public table (verified by query against pg_class).

tasks.title: [Phase 0] RLS cross-family test harness
tasks.description: Automated test proving a user can never read or write another family's rows. Required before any family-data feature is 'done'.
tasks.details:
Seed two families (A, B). For every table holding family data, assert: user A's session cannot SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE family B's rows, and vice versa. Run in CI on every migration change. This is the reusable harness referenced by Hard Rule #20 for all later features.
Hard Rules: #20 RLS test before 'done'; #1 RLS on every table.
tasks.testStrategy: CI test suite: 0 cross-family rows ever returned/mutated across all tables; suite fails the build if a new table lacks coverage.

tasks.title: [Phase 1] AI safety refer-out classifier + guardrails
tasks.description: A classifier that runs on EVERY AI turn; on safety/medical/developmental-concern signals the AI refers to a professional and does NOT advise. Never diagnoses. Cross-cutting, non-negotiable.
tasks.details:
On every ai-chat turn, run a refer-out classifier for: (a) possible developmental delay/clinical concern, (b) child-safety/abuse/self-harm, (c) medical issues. On detection, respond with warmth + direct to the right professional (pediatrician, child psychologist, helpline); do NOT advise or diagnose. Scope-fence to parenting/child-development; decline off-topic/unsafe. Log the event (flag only, no sensitive content) to ai_messages.flagged + the refer-out dashboard. Wire existing screen ai/refer_out_screen.dart.
Hard Rules: #7 refer-out every turn, never diagnose; #6 grounded; §6.3 PRD safety.
tasks.testStrategy: A battery of safety probes (abuse, self-harm, medical, delay) each trigger refer-out (no advice, no diagnosis); off-topic requests are declined; events logged with flag only (no PII). This gate must pass before Phase 1 ship.

tasks.title: [Phase 1] AI cost controls: routing, caps, caching, rate limit

tasks.details:

Cap max_output_tokens; cache the large static system prompt; small retrieval K; per-user soft rate limit with friendly messaging. Feed the AI cost dashboard (task 8). Target <$0.10 AI cost/active user/month.
Hard Rules: #8 cheap-by-default + escalate; #9 cap tokens, cache prompt, rate limit; #10 keys server-side.
tasks.testStrategy: 90%+ of turns stay on Flash; output tokens capped; system prompt cached (verified via token accounting); rate limit triggers friendly message; cost dashboard shows per-user trend under target.

Extend send-due-reminders to playdate/activity reminder types referencing scheduled_events. Add optional photo/note on activity_complete -> activity_logs.photo_url/note, stored in a PRIVATE Storage bucket served via signed URLs, with a file-size cap (e.g. 10MB). Feeds the memory timeline (task 30).
Hard Rules: #13 idempotent reminders; #16 private Storage + signed URLs + size cap; #18 tone.
tasks.testStrategy: A scheduled playdate fires a reminder once (idempotent) with a tip; a post-activity photo uploads to a private bucket and is only viewable via signed URL by the family.

tasks.title: [Phase 2] WhatsApp utility reminders (opt-in)
tasks.description: Deliver playdate/activity/recap reminders via WhatsApp Cloud API using pre-approved utility templates; opt-in + opt-out.
tasks.details:
Set up WABA + WhatsApp Cloud API; build whatsapp-send Edge Function. Submit + get approval for a small set of UTILITY templates (playdate reminder, activity reminder, weekly recap nudge) — never marketing. Capture + store explicit opt-in (users.whatsapp_opt_in, whatsapp_number E.164); honor opt-out. send-due-reminders routes to WhatsApp only for opted-in users; personalization via template variables. BLOCKER FOR FLORIE: confirm a WABA exists and Cloud-API-direct vs BSP.
Hard Rules: #11 push first/WhatsApp opt-in; #12 utility templates only; #13 idempotent.
tasks.testStrategy: An opted-in mom receives a utility-template reminder on WhatsApp; opt-out stops them; templates are approved as Utility; non-opted users only get push.

tasks.title: [Phase 2] Memory timeline + milestones
tasks.description: Private, scrollable feed of photos/notes from activities + milestones; capture developmental wins as a keepsake.
tasks.details:
Aggregate activity_logs (photo/note) + milestones (title, note, photo_url, date) into a timeline. Wire existing screen timeline/memory_timeline_screen.dart. Photos in private Storage + signed URLs.
Hard Rules: #16 private Storage + signed URLs; #20 RLS test; #15 minimal data.
tasks.testStrategy: A mom sees a private timeline of her activity photos/notes + milestones; nothing is visible to other families.

tasks.title: [Phase 2] Weekly recap
tasks.description: A gentle weekly summary: what you learned + did, plus one small thing to try next week.
tasks.details:
Summarize the week's reads + activities + bonding actions; suggest one next step. Wire existing screen timeline/weekly_recap_screen.dart. Can be delivered as a nudge (push, later WhatsApp recap template).
Hard Rules: #18 celebrate, never shame; #13 idempotent if pushed.
tasks.testStrategy: A mom receives a warm weekly recap with one suggested next step; tone reviewed.

tasks.title: [Phase 2] Gentle streak / consistency
tasks.description: Soft, encouraging consistency indicator — never harsh.
tasks.details:
A gentle streak surface celebrating small wins; never punishes a miss or shames a break.
Hard Rules: #18 no streak-shaming (this feature is the main risk for it).
tasks.testStrategy: Streak celebrates wins and shows no negative/guilt messaging on a missed day; tone sign-off.

tasks.title: [Phase 3] Co-parent / caregiver sharing (multi-member RLS)
tasks.description: Invite dad/grandparent to share a child profile and take part. Adds multi-member RLS via a security-definer membership check.
tasks.details:
Activate family_members; invite + accept flow (status invited/active). Membership-based access uses a SECURITY DEFINER function for the lookup (not a join-in-policy), structured as id IN (select ... where user = uid) to stay fast. Co-parent cannot delete the child or remove the owner.
Hard Rules: #3 security-definer membership fn; #1 RLS+index; #20 RLS test for multi-member isolation.
tasks.testStrategy: An invited co-parent sees the shared child + participates; cannot delete the child/owner; non-members still excluded; membership query stays <50ms.

tasks.title: [Phase 3] Audio letters
tasks.description: Mom and kid record short voice messages for each other / 'future you'.
tasks.details:
Voice recordings stored in private Storage + signed URLs, size-capped.
Hard Rules: #16 private Storage; #15 minimal data.
tasks.testStrategy: A recorded audio letter is private to the family and playable via signed URL.

tasks.title: [Phase 3] Voice input for AI
tasks.description: Speech-to-text for hands-full moments in the AI chat/situational modes.
tasks.details:
Add STT to the AI surfaces (after text works well). Same RAG + safety pipeline applies to transcribed input.
Hard Rules: #7 refer-out still runs; #10 keys server-side.
tasks.testStrategy: Spoken questions are transcribed and answered through the same grounded + safety-checked pipeline.

tasks.title: [Phase 3] Small moderated community (only if validated)
tasks.description: A small, expert-moderated community — built ONLY if retention/validation justifies it. Currently Out of Scope.
tasks.details: Deliberately deferred (PRD §13): a forum risks recreating the social-media overwhelm Momzo exists to escape. Build only if validated, and only as small + expert-moderated.
tasks.testStrategy: Gated on a go/no-go from real-user validation; not started otherwise.

tasks.title: [Phase 3] Billing / subscriptions (freemium)
tasks.description: Add IAP subscriptions + feature-gating AFTER retention is proven. Deferred entirely from Phase 1 (locked decision).
tasks.details:
Locked decision: billing deferred entirely, no feature-gating/IAP in Phase 1 — validate retention first. When added: Apple/Google IAP for the digital subscription; gate features by tier in-app AND enforce server-side in Edge Functions/RLS (proposed Free vs Momzo+ tiers, PRD §12).
Hard Rules: server-side enforcement of any gating (don't trust the client).
tasks.testStrategy: Tier entitlements enforced both in-app and server-side; purchase/restore works on iOS + Android.
